Package edu.scu.phantommaze.model

Class Pathfinder

java.lang.Object
edu.scu.phantommaze.model.Pathfinder
public class Pathfinder extends Object
Breadth-first search (BFS) over the tile grid.

distancesFrom(int, int, boolean, int[]) starts at one tile and spreads outward one step at a time, writing into every reachable tile how many steps away from the start it is. An enemy standing anywhere can then find the shortest way to the start tile by always stepping to the neighbor with the smallest number.

    • nearestMazeTile

      public int nearestMazeTile(int x, int y)
      Finds the maze tile closest to a point. Targets such as "4 tiles ahead of the player" often land inside a wall or off the map; this snaps them back onto the maze floor (never inside the pen).
      Parameters:
      x - desired tile column (may be outside the map)
      y - desired tile row (may be outside the map)
      Returns:
      the nearest maze tile's index(int, int), or UNREACHABLE if there is none
